objective: Reconnect bounded learned SS reading to signal-only generation, then designed three-occurrence composition. No claim of all-SS control, new language acquisition or free document planning.
training: Byte-identical v0.9 core. Refit component from432 text/meaning pairs and initial lexicon, temporal read/write from216 two-event pairs. Same SS feature selector, dimensions8192, temporal seed temporal-evaluation-0, selection seed selection-evaluation-0. Verify against original v0.9 model. No three-event training pairs; extending the structural loop/binding is designed, not learned.
corpus: Development4 unordered scenes per event-count and final12 per count. Final36 two-event documents and108 three-event documents,144 unique input texts. All3^(n-1) adjacent link combinations. Complete unordered event collections disjoint from temporal training and development. Known vocabulary/syntax reused. Semantic parts may be previously seen. Evaluation oracle is separate code, not independently annotated natural text.
meaning: 2 or3 local occurrence IDs. Five slots each: subject,object,predicate,polarity,modality. Every pair has explicit before direction or unknown; nonadjacent presentation pairs must be unknown. No transitive, causal, real-occurrence or general time inference. Input markers relate the immediately preceding textual occurrence. Presentation reverse preserves adjacency, unlike arbitrary permutation.
packet: Single complex phase vector. Count2/3, occurrence-bound slots, pair-bound time and presentation order are superposed and scaled by1/sqrt(3). No original text, event list, count or order hint in the envelope. Only schema, model fingerprint, dimension, real, imag, eligible_for_inference=false. Decoder enumerates a designed vocabulary and uses fixed0.65 score/0.25 margin/0.2 reconstruction residual thresholds from v0.9.
primary: Dimension8192, bound, three document-code seeds ssdoc-code-0/1/2. For every144 input: read, recover and compare independent gold; generate preserve/reverse with subject-all,object-all,alternating goals (6 outputs); independently parse and compare every event slot and explicit relation; re-read output and compare meaning modulo known presentation renaming. Also direct meaning->signal->generation once per input. Report wrong outputs, abstentions and exact/semantic correctness separately.144 inputs across3 seeds are not432 independent language samples.
diagnostics: Fixed subset first6 examples for each count, not performance-selected. For each of3 seeds: dimensions1024 and128 bound; full dimension unbound_events and undirected_time; full dimension zero_temporal_read/zero_temporal_write/zero_lexical_write with actual numerical learned coefficient bytes zeroed, headers unchanged. All diagnostic conditions use same data subset and preserve/subject goal. Negative ablations need not succeed. No post-final parameter tuning.
probes: 14 malformed/unsupported strings per primary seed. Valid representative three-event signal: zero,erase full event,add competing subject,50percent chip erasure,strong deterministic additive complex noise; evaluate accepted-wrong versus abstain, not require every corruption rejected. Controlled clean SS slot replacement and adjacent-edge reversal must change only intended meaning, with generation re-read independently scored. Tampered packet contract and model mismatch unit tests. Noise/masks are numerical stress, not P1 partial observation or S1 chip/pilot integration.
isolation: Separate generator subprocess with reader,trainer,selection,evaluator and training data removed. Transfer numeric packet and output goals only. Verify learned coefficients matter via zero-weight controls; no sentence template fallback. Ordinary designed punctuation/assembly, schema, endpoint renaming and acceptance logic remain. Link surface and lexical/role/gap correspondences recalled through SS memories; fixed-size runtime recall caches are counted and can be cleared.
evaluation_reuse: Existing v0.9 two-event regression evaluated with original saved cases as a separate regression, not new holdout evidence. Original artifacts not edited. Recent SS-active artificial-key teacher selection/trace mechanism is NOT integrated into language generation in this version; the connection is language-reader->document-SS->language-generator.
release: New standalone folder, all current code/training/evaluation/results/examples, hashes of old v0.9 and SS-active-v0.3. Main evaluation twice; functional signatures and numeric arrays compare exactly on this Windows environment, exclude timing. Isolated refit and generation, full unit tests, ZIP extraction and manifest check. No natural Japanese generalization, unlimited length, pronouns/ellipsis, learned document planning, main-memory capacity improvement, Linux validation or P1/S1 integration. eligible_for_inference=false.
